findings.finding: Initial image verifier accepted an initial successful run and its jobs without re-reading the run, and did not require a positive integer attempt. A rerun racing the jobs snapshot or malformed attempt could inherit prior green image evidence.
findings.evidence: Original S124 helper was copied byte-for-byte from retained S123 image verifier; offline controls against the retained original accepted rerun-during-jobs, missing-attempt and negative-attempt cases with only one run read.
findings.requiredFix: Validate positive integer attempt and complete unique jobs collection; re-read run after jobs and require the same successful attempt.
findings.resolution: Corrected verifier validates attempt/jobs and re-reads stable successful run. Nine independent offline cases pass.

findings.finding: Backend CI/image admission occurred before ops inventory and target/user/identity admission; it lacked a final stable run/attempt check immediately before mutation.
findings.requiredFix: Re-observe CI and image producer immediately before attempt marker and require unchanged successful run/attempt identities.
findings.resolution: CI and image admission are repeated immediately before final live target checks; run and attempt must match original admission.

findings.finding: Target age was checked before later bounded network admission and could expire beyond its own five-minute bound before mutation.
findings.requiredFix: Re-read live previous API/database state and re-check the five-minute target age immediately before the attempt marker.
findings.resolution: Final previous-source API/database readback and finalTargetAge are checked immediately before attempt marker.

frontend: Candidate source/artifact must match selected static manifest; staging native14/14 and byte-identical excluded metadata are observed afresh.
Complete upload path/byte inventory includes mirrors and rejects unexpected files and symlinks.

Required exact-candidate CI is checked twice; changed CI run/attempt refuses admission. Pages observation rejects executed red jobs/steps and stale attempt races without claiming pending workflow success.
Existing rollback ID, reviewed legacy-surface traces and installed Wrangler are required. No download fallback.
A durable attempt marker precedes brokered upload. Existing same-candidate attempt/completion refuses replay; provider/native observation is the recovery path.
Successful CLI upload alone is not completion: provider source match and production native14/14 are subsequently required.
backend: Candidate requires exact successful API/play image producer jobs and actual push steps, plus seven-job CI coverage.
Deploy script/ops diff and every tracked ops byte are compared to exact candidate; unexpected ops files/symlinks refuse upload.
Previous live API source is intentionally49035219. Those references are current rollback/admission scope, not stale S123 candidate coupling.
Backend target comes from read-only inspection of the expected service/config root and healthy existing database. It does not provision or migrate a database.
Existing gateway-resolved identity and pre-enrolled Ed25519 host pin are required. No keyscan, enrollment or private-key read/copy is performed by cache adapters.
Canonical deployer receives a non-secret sentinel in scratch. Native adapter substitutes only the existing identity argument, preserving pin, target, noninteractive options and token-only stdin.
Identity regular-file/realpath/size/mtime checks, exact command-family/target/options checks and bounded native processes constrain the adapter.
Existing backend attempt refuses replay. Native failures preserve redacted failure receipt; successful return still requires exact-source API/database readback.
sourceReview.staleSessionCoupling: No S123 imports or receipt paths remain in the seven prepared S124 helpers. Intentional490previous-source checks remain.

limitations: Prepared transport and offline verification do not prove deployment, live successful CI/image production or production readiness.
Approval applies only to the reviewed helper hashes and this exact selected candidate/artifact. Root owns fresh live admission and deployment observation.
Backend canonical transport retries only its defined connection failures; an interrupted top-level recorded attempt still requires live reconciliation rather than replay.
No credentials, private key material, provider host addresses or absolute local filesystem paths are included in this report.
